findings.reason: the plan must name the reader it reuses or extends (or state that a new G-EQDSK reader with a conversion receipt is the addition, and account its surface), exactly as §6 does for the SELENE deck conversion.
findings.text: §7 names E101011's G-EQDSK (`/home/d240034/fbequ/EFIT95.DATA`, plan lines 911–916 and decision `jt60sa-psi-q-source` at 1375) as the section's one psi grid and q profile, but names no reader or converter for a G-EQDSK anywhere: every other source in the plan has one (PSRC and the FAME scalars through `fetch_channels`/the existing channel extractor, the raw/equilibrium halves through `read_signal_map_observation`, MAST through `load_shot`), and no codebase named by the plan carries a reusable reader — `imas_ambix` and `packages/imas-alambic` hold none, and imas-efit's only G-EQDSK reader is the plotting-class method `utilities/plot/efitData.py:398 _read_eqdsk`, gated on the optional `pyEquilibrium` package, which the plan neither cites nor declines. The psi binding into `equilibrium/time_slice/profiles_2d` and the benchmark reference loader's psi reduction both depend on this source, so the section's headline deliverable rests on an unowned read

findings.reason: the section claims a single interface change while its one new source implies a second, and the budget line cannot be reconciled until the reader is named and accounted.
findings.text: §7 states "The section's interface change is the pin table below, which retires three public constants and their re-export", and separately accounts the frozen-shot-set table ("the one public addition in this section", line 993) and the two record fields (line 1092), but the psi/q reference at lines 911–916 requires a G-EQDSK reader that the section does not name — so a public definition is added (or required) with no retirement, merge, or statement of why nothing can be, against a week whose public_definitions is 0; the honest accounting is either that the reader is the section's addition and it retires something, or that it extends an existing reader

rubric_items.deep_module: pass — §6 splits the convention computation into a private kernel behind the two existing readers, and §7 extends the `efit_referee` seam and `build_geometry_from_arrays` rather than adding a comparator, so complexity sits behind interfaces smaller than what they hide.
rubric_items.duplicate_owner: pass — each shared mechanism the changed units touch names its owner and is extended in place: the pin table in `imas_ambix/gs/artifact_resolution.py`, the registry in `imas_ambix/gs/machine_identity.py` `default_registry`, the frozen shot set in `imas_ambix/spine_bench/shots.py`, the boundary reduction in `imas_ambix/worldmodel/equilibrium_labels.py` `build_geometry_from_arrays`, and the one SELENE read in §6's loader.
rubric_items.interface_budget: a finding — public_definitions 0, cli_options 0, mcp_views 0, refusal_families 0; §7 declares "the section's interface change is the pin table" while its psi/q reference requires a G-EQDSK reader, a new public definition the section neither retires, merges, nor explains.
rubric_items.reuse_search: a finding — §7's one psi/q source (E101011's G-EQDSK) names no reader or converter, while every other source names its owner; no prior-art search for a G-EQDSK reader is cited.
rubric_items.thin_wrapper: pass — the one adapter §7 adds (the SELENE reference loader) forwards to `build_geometry_from_arrays` and §6's SELENE loader with a stated reason it cannot read SELENE itself, so it is a justified seam-extension, not a bare forwarding layer over its own machinery.
